title: Stocks Gain Before Tech Earnings as Oil Declines: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
description: Stocks started the week on a positive note as crude oil retreated from a six-month high and investors awaited a busy slate of big-tech earnings for a steer on the artificial intelligence trade.

title: Eric Bauza, voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, dies at 46 - NBC News
description: Eric Bauza, best known for voicing the lovable “Looney Tunes” characters Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, has died, his family said Monday.

title: Meta plans $95bn stock offering to bankroll AI expansion - Financial Times
description: Chipmakers Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom will act as cornerstone investors

title: AI company Anthropic sued over alleged Elvis Presley copyright infringement - Fox News
description: Anthropic is accused of using copyrighted lyrics of 274 Elvis Presley songs to train its Claude AI models without permission, as legal battles over artificial intelligence intensify.

title: 12 injured, including 6 children, in shooting near Florida A&M University, police say - WESH
description: Twelve people were injured in the shooting, police said. Five victims have been released, and six remain hospitalized, including one in critical condition.
